correctness.rationale: A word induces a balanced directed multigraph with connected nonisolated support; conversely the Eulerian-circuit criterion constructs a cyclic word. Balance forces one signed three-cycle flow d. The cases d=0 and d nonzero, then 0,1,2,3 positive undirected reciprocal edges, are disjoint and exhaustive. Their geometric-series contributions yield the rational GF. The disconnected correction follows from precisely the remaining disjoint-loop and one-edge-plus-isolated-loop cases. Independent word and matrix enumerators test n<=10 and n<=12. No finite test substitutes for the symbolic proof.
